subject: SIG: Short-lived token rotation, merge gates, and deployment traceability
thread_text:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Northbridge Audit Team <cysec-audit@northbridge.co>, Acme Security <security@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG: Short-lived token rotation, merge gates, and deployment traceability

Hi team,

Per the SIG evidence request for FinBank, please find a concise summary of the controls we want to include in the package and a pointer to the artifacts. The auditor asked specifically for:
- rotation schedule for short-lived tokens used by CI runners
- evidence of merge/approval gates tied to deploy pipelines
- traceability from commit -> build -> deploy (audit log snippets)

Action items I propose:
1) Attach rotation schedule and map to pipeline jobs (Monica)
2) Export merge-gate audit CSV for the main repo (Karthik)
3) Collate CI runbook and sample logs showing successful key rotation (Rishi)

ETA: I suggest shipping an initial bundle by EOD Nov 3 and the signed SIG answers by Nov 9.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

---

From: Northbridge Audit Team <cysec-audit@northbridge.co>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Short-lived token rotation, merge gates, and deployment traceability

Jordan,

Thanks — that scope looks good. For the merge-gate evidence we need: the rule definition, policy enforcement logs for at least three sample merges, and the identity of reviewers (we'll accept GitHub/Bitbucket metadata exports). For token rotation, the auditor wants both the schedule and a rendered example of a rotated secret showing the old/expiry metadata masked.

If you can provide CSVs and a single PDF with the mapping narrative we can start our intake review.

Regards,
Northbridge Assessment Team
[cysec-audit@northbridge.co]

---

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Northbridge Audit Team <cysec-audit@northbridge.co>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 14:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Short-lived token rotation, merge gates, and deployment traceability

Jordan / team — attaching the CI runbook excerpt and the rotation schedule. I've redacted live token values and included the rotation job names and cron schedules. Also included are links to the pipeline jobs that call the KMS integration.

[Attachment: ci_pipeline_runbook.pdf]
[Attachment: rotation-schedule.xlsx]

Notes:
- Our CI runners leverage short-lived tokens issued by our internal token service; tokens are valid for 1 hour by default.
- Rotation job runs are triggered on a daily cadence for service accounts and on-demand for ephemeral runners after key use thresholds.
- The runbook contains the playbook for rotating a compromised credential (step-by-step with roll-forward/rollback).

I'll run a couple of sample exports of the pipeline executions and upload the CSVs to the shared Drive tomorrow.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Northbridge Audit Team <cysec-audit@northbridge.co>
Date: Mon, 6 Nov 2028 11:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Short-lived token rotation, merge gates, and deployment traceability

Monica — uploaded the merge-gate audit export and a small CSV with three sample merges from the main repo. The CSV includes: merge_id, author, reviewer, timestamp, pipeline_status. I also included a short notes column showing the automatic gate checks that blocked a deploy when checks failed.

[Attachment: merge-gate-audit.csv]

One operational note: our merge gate is a suite of required checks (static analysis, license scan, unit test coverage threshold). Manual reviewer approval is required for any deploy to production; that is enforced by branch protection and the deployment pipeline will abort if approvals are missing.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Core Tooling
Redwood Inference

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Northbridge Audit Team <cysec-audit@northbridge.co>, Acme Security <security@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Nov 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Short-lived token rotation, merge gates, and deployment traceability

Hi Northbridge — attaching the consolidated package for intake. The ZIP in Drive includes: CI runbook excerpt, rotation-schedule (spreadsheet with masked timestamps), merge-gate audit CSV, sample build -> deploy trace logs (redacted), and our signed SIG answer PDF.

Quick summary of evidentiary items included:
- ci_pipeline_runbook.pdf: runbook sections 4.2–4.6 showing KMS integration and emergency rotation steps.
- rotation-schedule.xlsx: scheduled jobs, TTLs, rotation ownership, and last-run timestamps (masked).
- merge-gate-audit.csv: three representative merges showing reviewer identity and gate outcomes.
- build_to_deploy_trace.log: excerpt demonstrating commit hash -> build id -> deploy id mapping and the associated audit timestamps.
- sig_signed_answers.pdf: completed SIG questionnaire (signed by security leadership).

We applied standard redaction (masking of secrets and obfuscation of unique tokens) and preserved metadata required by the auditor. If you need deeper raw logs or additional RBAC policy extracts, let us know — we can provide an HMAC-signed bundle with limited access for the assessment window.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Software Engineer, Reliability
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: sig_signed_answers.pdf]
[Attachment: build_to_deploy_trace.log]

---

From: Northbridge Audit Team <cysec-audit@northbridge.co>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Nov 2028 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Short-lived token rotation, merge gates, and deployment traceability

Rishi / team — received. Intake review looks clean; we'll follow up if the assessor needs raw logs. Early feedback: the rotation schedule and runbook provide good coverage; we may ask for a sampled KMS audit extract to show key binding to service accounts for a single day.

Thank you — intake accepted and moving to formal review.

— Northbridge Assessment Team
